newsFlag.summary: Juszczyk missed Tuesday practice due to an ongoing finger injury, though he practiced Monday and the absence may be veteran management.
Undisclosed
Personal
Mike Evans is dealing with a groin/adductor injury and will miss practice this week, with the team hoping to have him back next week before the season opener in Australia.
Jason Myers is active but experiencing an unusual preseason accuracy slump after a strong 2025 regular season, though no injury is indicated.
Darren Waller is being eased into the Panthers offense during the preseason and will miss the preseason finale, but there is no injury designation reported.
Mariota returned to practice Monday after missing two weeks with a sprained MCL in his right knee and is working to increase his workload ahead of the 2026 season.
Undisclosed
McCaffrey has returned to practice and is participating in full drills, trending positively toward Week 1 availability despite an undisclosed injury designation.
Kittle is being eased back from an Achilles injury after activation from PUP and is uncertain for Week 1 against the Rams despite a push to play in the season opener.

Deshaun Watson was named the Browns' starting quarterback after winning a preseason job battle, though he has a significant injury history including a torn Achilles tendon and re-rupture that sidelined him for the entire 2025 season.
James Conner has been placed on injured reserve with a designation to return due to ongoing foot injury complications, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Mitchell Trubisky is day-to-day with a biceps injury sustained during practice and did not participate in Wednesday's session, but the injury is reportedly not considered serious.
Mahomes is on track to start Week 1 despite recovering from a torn left ACL sustained last December, with reports indicating he is extremely confident in his readiness.
Kamara sustained an MCL sprain and is expected to be out for at least one month, putting his Week 1 availability in jeopardy and making him a candidate to open the season on injured reserve.
Jeremy McNichols was placed on injured reserve with a quadriceps injury and won't be eligible to return until at least Week 5 of the 2026 season.
Ray-Ray McCloud was placed on injured reserve by the Bears with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Christian Kirk was placed on injured reserve with a calf injury suffered in July practice and will miss at least the first four games of the regular season.
Moore suffered an ankle injury in a preseason game but has returned to practice and is expected to be available for Week 1 of the regular season.
Jakobi Meyers jammed his right hand during Wednesday's joint practice and is uncertain to play in the preseason finale against Tampa Bay on Aug. 28.
D.J. Montgomery was placed on injured reserve by the Colts due to an abdominal injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Hockenson is active and remains the Vikings' top tight end, though he saw limited preseason snaps and continues recovery from a 2023 ACL/MCL injury.
Devin Singletary is not in uniform for Friday's preseason game against the Jets, though this appears to be a rest decision rather than an injury concern.
Undisclosed
David Sills was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss at least four games, with earliest return in Week 5.
Ty Johnson remains sidelined with a lower leg injury but has resumed running and sprinting, with limited fantasy relevance due to his backup role behind James Cook and Ray Davis.
Undisclosed
Metcalf dealt with an undisclosed injury during training camp but has returned to practice and is expected to be ready for Week 1 against the Falcons.
Achilles
A.J. Brown is inactive for Thursday's preseason game but this appears to be a routine preseason rest decision with no injury concern indicated.
Josh Jacobs was placed on the Commissioner's Exempt List following misdemeanor charges from a domestic incident and is ineligible to practice or play pending his court appearance on November 17.

Dobbins recently recovered from a soft-tissue injury and was cleared to return to practice, but sat out preseason action in street clothes with his availability for the preseason finale still unclear.
Pittman missed practice time and preseason action due to a hamstring injury but has returned to practice and is expected to be ready for Week 1.
AJ Dillon played in the preseason game and is active, though he has limited recent playing time and could see increased role if other RBs remain injured.
Jeudy will not play in the Browns' preseason game against the Bills on Saturday, though the reason for his absence is not specified as injury-related.
Tee Higgins is dealing with a heel contusion but coach Zac Taylor indicated it is not a major concern and he should be ready for the Week 1 opener against Tampa Bay.
Chuba Hubbard returned to practice Tuesday while recovering from a mid-August hamstring injury and is trending positively toward being ready for the start of the season.
Waddle played in preseason and looked unencumbered by earlier leg tightness, though his playing time may be limited before Week 1.
Hamstring
Jermar Jefferson was placed on injured reserve by the Vikings with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Brock Wright is active and participated in Thursday's preseason game, with potential increased opportunity if Sam LaPorta's hip injury prevents him from Week 1 availability.
Ben Skowronek suffered a concussion in Thursday's preseason game and entered the NFL's concussion protocol, requiring clearance from an independent neurologist before he can return to play.

Ja'Marr Chase is recovering from a left knee hyperextension suffered during practice and will be limited in practice this week, but Coach Taylor expects him to be ready for the Week 1 matchup against Tampa Bay.
DeVonta Smith is a full participant in practice after returning in limited capacity last week, ramping up from a hamstring injury as the season approaches.
Trevor Lawrence will not play in Friday's preseason game against the Panthers, though this appears to be a routine rest decision rather than an injury.
Travis Etienne is healthy and set to receive an expanded workload due to teammate Alvin Kamara's MCL sprain expected to sideline him for at least a month.
Trey Sermon was placed on injured reserve by the Falcons with an undisclosed injury, making him unavailable for the 2026 season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Knee
Cole Turner was waived/injured by Miami and reverted to the injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury, requiring an injury settlement to have any chance of playing in 2026.
Grant Calcaterra was placed on injured reserve with a back injury and will be sidelined until at least Week 5.
Melton played in preseason action but faces roster uncertainty due to poor performance and competition for his special teams role.
Irvin Charles was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return due to an undisclosed preseason injury and will miss at least the first four regular season games.
Isiah Pacheco was placed on injured reserve due to a back injury suffered during training camp, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Cameron Dicker is working through an unspecified issue and was not at 100% in the preseason finale, leaving his Week 1 status uncertain despite head coach Jim Harbaugh expressing relative confidence.
Rachaad White is sidelined with a hamstring injury and will miss the Commanders' final two preseason games, though he is making progress in recovery.
Khalil Shakir has been sidelined with an undisclosed injury since Aug. 20, missed the final two preseason games, and remains out of practice with less than two weeks until the regular season opener.
Ty Chandler suffered a season-ending knee injury during a preseason game and has been placed on injured reserve, missing the entire 2026 season.
Chris Oladokun reverted to the Chiefs' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Skylar Thompson has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Brittain Brown was placed on injured reserve by the Chicago Bears due to an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Groin
Metchie is active and participated in preseason action, though he has a history of injury issues and is competing for a roster spot on the Panthers.
Alec Pierce is working back from offseason ankle surgery and missed most of training camp and preseason, but the Colts hope he will play in Week 1 against the Ravens.
Calvin Austin III was placed on injured reserve after suffering a torn ACL during practice and will miss the entire 2026 season.
Robinson sustained a hard hit during Thursday's joint practice but concussion tests were negative, with early indications suggesting he remains on track for Week 1.
Breece Hall is recovering ahead of schedule from a minor groin strain and participated in agility drills, likely to miss the preseason game but targeting Week 1 availability.
Cade Otton returned to practice after missing about a week with an undisclosed injury and his availability for the preseason finale remains uncertain.
Kenneth Walker III is dealing with ankle swelling but head coach Andy Reid expects him to be fine with no concern about extended absence.
Will Mallory was placed on injured reserve with a thumb injury and will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 regular season, eligible to return in Week 5.
Keaton Mitchell is missing his fourth consecutive practice due to an undisclosed injury but is working with trainers on the side, with the Chargers GM expecting him to play in Week 1.
Kendre Miller exited Tuesday's practice with an apparent injury, though there is no indication it is serious, leaving the Saints with limited healthy running back depth behind Travis Etienne.
Undisclosed
Scott Matlock was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the 2026 season, with earliest return in Week 5.
Brayden Willis was ruled out for the remainder of Thursday's preseason game due to a concussion.
Tyrell Shavers was placed on the reserve/PUP list due to a torn ACL suffered in the wild-card round and will miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season.
Knee
Princeton Fant has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Jake Bobo suffered a serious knee injury during a joint practice with the Titans and was placed on injured reserve, ruling him out for the entire 2026 season.
Nate Adkins returned to practice Monday after leaving Friday's session with a trainer, indicating a minor injury that doesn't appear to be serious.
Emanuel Wilson has been designated as questionable for upcoming games.
Undisclosed
Marvin Mims Jr. suffered a bruised foot in the preseason finale and missed practice Monday, with two weeks until the regular season to recover.
Tank Dell remains on injured reserve with a knee injury and must miss at least the first four games, though the GM indicated he is getting closer to a return.
Addison jammed his thumb in training camp but played in the preseason opener, catching one pass for eight yards with no indication of ongoing availability concerns.
Tucker Kraft is expected to be 'full go' for the Packers' Week 1 opener after recovering from a torn ACL suffered 10 months prior, though he is being rested in the preseason finale as a precaution.
Josh Downs sustained a minor calf injury last week but participated in Tuesday's practice, suggesting he could be cleared for the Week 1 season opener against the Ravens.
Zay Flowers is recovering from a left quadriceps bruise sustained in early August but is expected to return to full practice next week and be available for the Ravens' Week 1 season opener.
Sam LaPorta returned to practice Tuesday after dealing with a hip injury, showing positive progress with over two weeks remaining before the regular-season opener.
Rashee Rice returned to game action for the first time since a December concussion and appears healthy heading into Week 1, though his offseason included a knee procedure and legal issues.
Davis Allen is recovering from a quadriceps injury and participated in limited practice Monday, likely to miss the preseason finale but working toward availability for the regular-season opener.
Puka Nacua (groin) is gradually ramping up in practice after missing time during the offseason, with 10 days until Week 1 to continue his recovery.
Luke Musgrave was placed on the PUP list and will miss at least the first four weeks of the 2026 season due to a neck injury sustained during June minicamp, with an uncertain timeline for activation.
Jayden Reed is being rested for Friday's preseason game in Denver as a precautionary measure after briefly missing practice time earlier in the month, but has otherwise remained active and available.
Zach Charbonnet suffered an ACL tear in his left knee on Jan. 17 and is expected to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Johnny Wilson reverted to Philadelphia's injured reserve with a knee injury and will miss the upcoming season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Chris Collier reverted to injured reserve with the Raiders due to an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season unless an injury settlement is reached.
Undisclosed
Malik Nabers has a knee injury and was uncertain about Week 1 availability, though he did participate in Tuesday's practice midway through the session.
Xavier Legette sustained an ankle injury during Wednesday's joint practice and will wear a walking boot until Thursday, likely missing Friday's preseason game against the Texans.
Brooks missed Tuesday practice due to general soreness but the injury doesn't appear serious after he played in the preseason.
Isaac Guerendo was placed on the reserve/PUP list and will miss at least the first four weeks of the season due to a pectoral injury.
Groin
Jamari Thrash has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Tyrone Tracy Jr. suffered a neck stinger in the preseason finale and is practicing in a non-contact jersey, leaving his availability uncertain for the upcoming season.
Joe Milton III was waived by the Cowboys, making him unavailable for fantasy purposes.
Xavier Weaver is listed as questionable for an upcoming game, indicating his availability is uncertain.
Bradley is on injured reserve with a thumb injury suffered in the final preseason game and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement with Jacksonville.
Brooks has returned to practice after hand surgery in early August and is working toward being available for the preseason finale.
Mason Tipton was placed on the reserve/PUP list after undergoing tibia surgery in the offseason and will miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season, with earliest return in Week 5.
Cole Burgess has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Jeshaun Jones received a three-game NFL suspension for violating the substance-abuse policy and will be ineligible for game action until Week 4.
Tip Reiman was moved to the reserve/PUP list due to an ankle injury and must miss at least four games before becoming eligible to return.
Braelon Allen started at RB in place of the injured Breece Hall and is the team's top available running back, but faces potential competition from Isaiah Davis once he returns from injury.
Isaiah Davis (knee) returned to limited on-field work with a trainer during Tuesday's practice after missing the first two preseason games, but his availability for Friday's game remains uncertain.
MarShawn Lloyd is now the top available option in the Packers backfield with Josh Jacobs sidelined, presenting a short-term fantasy opportunity despite limited regular-season experience.
Erick All passed his conditioning test and is cleared to participate in training camp after undergoing multiple knee surgeries for an ACL injury that caused him to miss the entire 2025 season.
Theo Johnson is participating in non-contact practice after a shoulder injury sustained last Monday and is on track to play Week 1 against the Cowboys.
McMillan remains sidelined with a knee injury at practice but there is optimism he will be available for Week 1 against the Bengals in 12 days.

Brian Thomas Jr. suffered a shoulder injury during Tuesday's practice but returned Wednesday in limited capacity with a no-contact jersey, with coaching staff indicating caution for the preseason finale but optimism for the season opener.
Keon Coleman is recovering from a right foot/toe sprain sustained in the preseason opener and has progressed to practicing without his walking boot, with nearly two weeks before Week 1.
Undisclosed
Jaylen Daniels is active and returning from an elbow injury that caused him to miss the last four games of the 2025 regular season, with limited preseason snaps as he works back to full form.
Ben Sinnott is dealing with an oblique injury and will miss the preseason finale, but his availability for the season opener has not been ruled out.
Knee - PCL
Penix is recovering from a torn ACL and will miss Friday's preseason game but expects to be available for Week 1 against the Steelers, though he's still in final recovery stages.
Trey Benson reverted to injured reserve due to ongoing knee troubles from a meniscus injury suffered in Week 4, and was unable to remain healthy despite returning to play.
J.J. McCarthy remains on the Vikings' 53-man roster with an ankle injury but is expected to back up the starting quarterback.
Thomas Yassmin was reverted to injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches a settlement with the Packers.
Savion Williams is on injured reserve with a high-ankle sprain and is expected to return Week 5 for his 2026 debut on October 11.
Tyler Loop is expected to handle Week 1 kicking duties despite recent missed field goals in the preseason and the Ravens adding Jake Moody to the practice squad, putting him on a short leash.
Jimmy Holiday was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Ashton Jeanty is working off to the side during practice after sustaining an ankle injury on Aug. 23, showing progress but with his Week 1 status still to be confirmed.
Tyler Warren (adductor strain) participated in Tuesday's practice and is expected to have no restrictions for Week 1 against the Ravens.
Egbuka is dealing with a toe injury that has sidelined him since mid-August and is not practicing, leaving his Week 1 availability uncertain despite coach optimism.
Jayden Higgins was placed on injured reserve after suffering a torn ACL in practice, ending his 2026 season before it started.
Hamstring
Ayomanor exited Thursday's practice early with a left shoulder issue but is practicing Friday and avoided a serious injury.
Jordan James returned to action in preseason after dealing with a rib fracture, logging 8 rushes for 35 yards and 1 reception for 20 yards.

Ollie Gordon II suffered a minor rib injury during preseason but would have been cleared to return in a regular-season game, with his practice participation to be monitored regarding his availability for the preseason finale.
Devin Neal was placed on injured reserve with a hamstring injury sustained during preseason and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Will Howard suffered a concussion during Thursday's preseason game and is in the NFL's five-step concussion protocol with uncertain availability.
Kalel Mullings has been designated as Questionable and his availability for upcoming games is uncertain.
Knee - ACL
Kyle Monangai sustained a right knee hyperextension on Aug. 16 and is week-to-week, putting his availability for the Bears' season opener on Sept. 13 at risk.
Johnson returned to action in the third preseason game after missing two exhibitions due to an Aug. 4 groin strain, recording one catch for nine yards.
LeQuint Allen Jr. is listed as questionable and his availability status for upcoming games is uncertain.
Caleb Lohner was placed on injured reserve with a lower-body injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the 2026 regular season, with the earliest return being Week 5.

Croskey-Merritt missed the final two preseason games due to a lower-body injury and won't practice Monday, but is expected to return to practice next week with his participation level to be determined before the regular-season opener.
Moliki Matavao was placed on injured reserve due to a knee injury sustained in a preseason game and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Jacoby Jones was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach a settlement with the Commanders to become a free agent rather than spend the 2026 season on IR.
Ja'Quinden Jackson was placed on injured reserve after being waived with an injury designation and left a preseason game in an ambulance, though CT scans were negative.
Coleman Owen was placed on injured reserve by the Colts after suffering a concussion during the preseason finale and will miss the entire season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Beaux Collins was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return, requiring him to miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season due to an undisclosed injury.
Carter Runyon was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and is eligible to return in Week 5, missing at least the first four games of the 2026 regular season.
Dontae Fleming was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Undisclosed
Undisclosed
Corey Kiner was traded from the Cardinals to the Patriots and is positioned as the No. 3 running back, with potential to see increased snaps if TreVeyon Henderson's ankle keeps him sidelined.
Brock Lampe was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Arm
Dont'e Thornton Jr. was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and must miss at least the first four games of the 2025 regular season.
Kurtis Rourke suffered three broken ribs in the preseason opener but has a chance to return next week according to Coach Shanahan.
Dalevon Campbell suffered a significant leg injury in practice and has been placed on injured reserve for the 2026 regular season.
Trevor Etienne was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return after suffering an ankle injury in the preseason finale, requiring him to miss at least four games.
Tory Horton has been sidelined with an undisclosed injury for over a week, but his head coach confirmed it is not a long-term or significant injury.
Robbie Ouzts has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Hampton is active and serving as the Chargers' lead back after missing time last season with a fractured left ankle, though he saw limited snaps in the preseason finale.
Dillon Gabriel has been placed on injured reserve with a back injury deemed not serious by coach Todd Monken, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of 2026.
Tre Harris missed the final two preseason games with an undisclosed injury but is expected to be available for the regular-season opener.
Henderson is rehabbing a right ankle injury and hasn't been cleared for full practice participation ahead of Week 1, though he was observed walking normally.

Luther Burden III is recovering from a groin injury suffered in early August and is gradually returning to practice participation, with his availability for Week 1 still uncertain despite recent progress.
Ferguson is dealing with soreness and working off to the side at practice, but is expected to be available for games.
Isaiah Bond has been designated as questionable for upcoming games.
Carson Towt has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Makai Lemon made his pro debut after overcoming a hamstring injury and is expected to fill the No. 3 receiver role despite limited production in the preseason game.
Sarratt is healthy and active but facing roster competition and declining production in preseason, creating uncertainty about his spot on the 53-man roster.
Adam Randall was placed on injured reserve by the Ravens with a designation to return due to an undisclosed injury and will miss at least the first four games of the regular season.
Jaren Kanak has been placed on Injured Reserve.
Dominic Richardson was placed on the Jets' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach an injury settlement to have any chance of playing in 2026.
DJ Rogers, a tight end, suffered an MCL sprain during preseason and has been placed on injured reserve for the entire 2026 regular season.
Jeff Caldwell hyperextended his left knee during practice and has been placed on injured reserve, likely sidelining him for the entire 2026 regular season.
Knee
EJ Smith reverted to the Chiefs' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with injury settlement.
Chase Roberts was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches a settlement with the Raiders.
Undisclosed

Jeremiyah Love is nursing a high-ankle sprain from his preseason debut and has not yet participated in full practice, but the coaching staff believes he is progressing well toward availability for Week 1.
Jordyn Tyson was placed on injured reserve with a right hamstring injury expected to sideline him for approximately two months, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Kenyon Sadiq is on track to play Week 1 despite a hernia that caused him to miss training camp and the entire preseason, but he will have a limited role as he ramps up activity.
De'Zhaun Stribling is sidelined with a shoulder injury and will miss Thursday's preseason game against Las Vegas, but is expected to be ready for Week 1 against the Rams.
Oscar Delp is nursing a hamstring injury at Saints training camp with unclear severity, but has time to practice before the preseason finale.
Hurst is active and healthy but faces reduced playing time if injured teammates (Egbuka, McMillan, Johnson) return for Week 1.
Joe Royer was placed on the reserve/non-football illness list and must miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season due to a personal issue.
Undisclosed
Carsen Ryan returned to play in Thursday's preseason game after exiting Tuesday's practice early with a foot injury, catching both targets for nine yards.
Haynes King suffered a hamstring injury in the Hall of Fame Game and will miss the final three preseason games, putting his roster spot in jeopardy.

Quentin Moore was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless released with an injury settlement.

Chip Trayanum was placed on injured reserve by the Jets due to a neck injury suffered in the preseason finale and will miss the entire 2026 season.

Carnell Tate missed Tuesday's practice due to stiffness but is expected to be available for Week 1.

Eli Stowers is dealing with a hamstring injury and may have limited fantasy value even after recovery due to his low position on the Eagles' tight end depth chart behind Goedert, Mundt, and Calcaterra.

Jadarian Price has recovered from his lower-body injury and will not play in the preseason finale as a healthy scratch, but is expected to play in Week 1 with starting running back Zach Charbonnet unavailable due to a knee injury.
Will Kacmarek is week-to-week with an undisclosed injury and did not play in the preseason finale.
Bell cleared to play after ACL surgery in December and saw action in the preseason finale, though he is competing for playing time in a crowded receiver room.

Coleman returned from an undisclosed injury to play in Saturday's preseason game, catching 2 of 5 targets for 32 yards, though he appears to be lower on the depth chart behind several other receivers.
Brenen Thompson returned to practice in a non-contact jersey after missing Saturday's session due to an undisclosed injury, but is expected to play in Thursday's preseason finale.
Connor Hulstein was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach an injury settlement with the Jets to have any chance to play in 2026.
